content.short: Ridotto is a decentralized, cross-chain gambling and lottery protocol featuring NFT-based liquidity.
content.description: Ridotto is a pioneering decentralized gambling protocol that leverages blockchain technology to offer a transparent and community-driven alternative to traditional casinos. Built with cross-chain compatibility, including Cardano, the platform allows users to stake assets and participate in various games and lotteries. A key feature of Ridotto is its utility NFTs, which enable holders to 'become the house' and earn a share of the protocol's revenue by providing liquidity to the platform's games. Governed by the $RDT token, Ridotto prioritizes fairness, security, and decentralized participation.
